spans.s:
m. (-ता)
A priest, who at a sacrifice recites the prayers of the Rig Veda; one conversant with that Veda.
E.
हु to sacrifice, Uṇādi aff. तृच्.

n. (-त्रं)
1 An article intended or fit for offering with fire, generally clarified butter.
2 Burnt-offering, oblation with fire.
E.
हु to sacrifice, ष्ट्रन् aff.

n. (-यं)
A place where oblations are offered.
m. (-यः)
A priest offering an oblation.
E.
होत्र an offering, छ aff.
